groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: 🔴 Negative
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.872% and the 10Y at 5.060%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 6 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +6.09% over five sessions and +4.29% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.16% at about $99.41, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-19/100, deteriorating ↓). The tension is between persistent semiconductor momentum, supportive options positioning on the supportive side and elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, rising volatility on the headwind side.

The important trigger is US10Y at 5.00%. A sustained break above roughly 5.00–5.05% while the 2Y remains near 4.87% would materially weaken the setup, especially if semiconductor leadership also deteriorates. A retreat in the 10Y with continued semiconductor strength would reinforce the positive setup. Elevated consolidation risk is tempering the directional setup.
